rpg_public_disabled: The RPG is not enabled on this server.
rpg_public_raid_open: Raid running, level {level}. Each clan faces its own instance of the boss.
rpg_public_raid_guild_mode: Raid running, level {level}. It is played in RPG guilds: clans are not pitted against each other.
rpg_public_raid_none: No window is open or scheduled right now.
eco_quests_desc: Game goals to reach within a time window: monsters killed, bosses downed, raid assaults, loot, fishing. A quest counts for one member, or for a whole clan pushing the same counter.
eco_quests_clans_off: The Clans module is off: team quests can only target RPG guilds, and no clan points will be paid.
eco_quests_empty: No quest: nothing is offered to players.
eco_quest_scope_member_desc: Each member has their own progress and claims their own reward.
eco_quest_scope_team_desc: The whole team pushes the same counter. The reward is split in proportion and paid automatically.
eco_recipes_desc: What a player can craft at the workshop, from materials looted off monsters or bought.
eco_recipes_empty: No recipe. The server only uses the ones shipped with the bot.
eco_recipe_shipped_hint: Shipped recipes are shared by every server and cannot be edited here.
eco_recipe_material_required: Every material must name an item.
eco_quest_window_hint: The window is clock-aligned: 24 h resets at midnight UTC, 6 h at 00, 06, 12 and 18. Every team runs the same clock.
eco_quest_rewards_bridge_hint: Clan points are only paid while the RPG to clans bridge is open, in the Bosses & Monsters tab.
eco_quest_rewards_member_hint: Paid on claim, by the player, once the target is reached.
eco_quest_rewards_team_hint: Pools shared between participants: 30% split evenly, the rest in proportion to what each brought. Paid automatically on completion.
eco_quest_enabled_desc: A disabled quest is no longer offered and stops counting.
eco_quest_delete_confirm: Delete \u00ab {name} \u00bb? Progress in flight disappears with it.
eco_quest_team_unavailable: No team module is enabled for this mode: the quest would never count anything.
eco_raid_desc: Once a week a boss opens for a few hours. Each team faces its own instance, with a health pool that follows its size: every team runs the same trial, and the largest one cannot monopolise the health bar.
eco_raid_toggle_desc: Requires a team module: server clans, or RPG guilds.
eco_raid_mode_clan_desc: Membership is read from the Discord role. Rewards go through clan points, with the season, the standings and debt repayment.
eco_raid_mode_clan_off: The Clans module is off: turn it on to use this mode.
eco_raid_mode_guild_desc: Membership is read from the game profile. Team points go to guild XP instead of clan points.
eco_raid_mode_guild_off: RPG guilds are off: turn them on in the Configuration tab.
eco_raid_auto_desc: The raid opens on the configured day and hour. Turn this off to launch it by hand only.
eco_raid_start_hint: The window opens right away and the announcement is posted at once in the chosen channel.
eco_raid_start_unsaved: Save your settings first: the launch uses what is saved, not what is on screen.
eco_raid_start_confirm_desc: The announcement goes out immediately and the window stays open for {hours} h. A launched raid cannot be taken back.
eco_raid_window_hint: The hour follows the server timezone. The next raid is scheduled as soon as the previous one closes.
eco_item_raid_assaults_hint: Drunk during an open raid, the potion grants these assaults on top of the quota. The server caps it at {max} per member per raid.
eco_raid_bought_assaults_hint: Cap on the assaults a member can buy through potions on one raid. At zero, nothing can be bought.
eco_raid_health_preview: A team of 3 faces {small} HP, a team of 20 faces {large}.
eco_raid_rewards_hint: Amounts are set per member: a team's pool follows its size, just like its health reserve. It is shared between participants, 30% split evenly and the rest in proportion to damage. A team that fails to bring the boss down gets a quarter.
eco_raid_reward_points_hint: Paid member by member, to their clan and for the current season.
eco_raid_reward_guild_xp_hint: Paid to the RPG guild that led the raid, levelling it up.
eco_raid_announce_hint: The message carries the assault button and each team's progress bar. Without an announcement, nobody can strike.
eco_raid_consolation_hint: Share of the pool paid to a team that struck without bringing its boss down. At zero, only victory pays.
eco_raid_recap_closed: Ended on {date}. These results stay until the next raid opens.
eco_raid_bosses_desc: These sheets belong to this server. Spells are picked from the shipped catalogue: they give each boss its way of fighting, not just its numbers.
eco_raid_restore_hint: Puts back the shipped bosses that are missing, without touching yours.
eco_raid_restore_none: Every shipped boss is already here.
eco_raid_no_boss: No raid boss: the raid cannot open.
eco_raid_no_spell: No spell: the boss only hits.
eco_raid_spells_desc: One spell per turn, when it is off cooldown. Phase spells take priority, which makes the end of a fight differ from its start.
eco_raid_enabled_desc: A disabled boss is never drawn.
eco_raid_delete_confirm: Delete \u00ab {name} \u00bb? Past raids keep their record.
eco_bm_desc: A clandestine stall opening at unpredictable days and times. Every member sees their own selection of shop items, heavily discounted and in limited supply.
eco_bm_toggle_desc: Requires the RPG shop: offers are drawn from purchasable items.
eco_bm_requires_shop: Enable the RPG shop first in the Configuration tab: with no purchasable items, the black market has nothing to offer.
eco_bm_interval_hint: Average gap between two openings. The exact moment stays random.
eco_bm_duration_hint: Window during which members can buy.
eco_toast_bm_discount_invalid: The minimum discount must be lower than or equal to the maximum discount.
eco_toast_bm_channel_required: Select an announcement channel for the black market.
eco_toast_bm_role_required: Select a role to mention for the black market.
eco_rpg_toggle_desc: Unlocks the /rpg-travel command and random events.
eco_shop_toggle_desc: Allows buying gear, equipping weapons, and using potions.
eco_guilds_toggle_desc: Allows forming alliances, cooperating, and having a guild chest.
eco_icon_hint: PNG, JPG, or SVG. Displayed with priority on the dashboard.
eco_limits_desc: Caps applied to gambling games and member-to-member transfers.
eco_max_daily_bets: Games per day and per member
eco_reset_section_desc: Irreversible actions. Allows resetting all or part of the server economy.
eco_players_reset_all_hint: Erases stored RPG profiles: balances, levels, inventories. The search box does not narrow it down, every player in the list is affected.
eco_no_items: No items available in the shop.
eco_no_attrs_needed: No specific attributes required for this item.
eco_reset_modal_desc: Are you sure you want to reset component {component}? This operation will permanently delete associated data and is completely irreversible!
eco_toast_daily_invalid: Maximum daily reward must be greater than or equal to minimum reward.
eco_toast_raid_channel_required: Pick an announcement channel for the raid: that is where it gets attacked from.
eco_toast_raid_announce_required: The raid is fought from its announcement button: pick an announcement mode.
eco_toast_raid_team_mode_off: The team module picked for the raid is off: turn it on, switch mode, or disable the raid.
eco_toast_raid_role_required: Pick a role to mention for the raid.
eco_delete_item_confirm: Delete this item from the shop?
que_page_desc: Daily and weekly quests with rewards.
que_template_subtitle: Select a pre-configured template or create a custom quest
mar_empty_listings_desc: Players can create listings using the /market command.
giv_page_desc: Create and manage interactive raffles with entry buttons.
giv_empty_text: No giveaways configured at the moment.
giv_modal_subtitle: Configure and deploy a giveaway on Discord.
giv_cfg_managers_desc: Who can start, end, reroll and delete a giveaway.
giv_cfg_managers_help: These roles add to administrators and members with «Manage Messages». They get the /giveaway command on Discord and the actions on this page.
giv_cfg_participation_desc: Who can click a giveaway's «Join» button.
giv_cfg_required_help: Leave empty to open giveaways to the whole server.
giv_cfg_blocked_help: Take priority over required roles: an excluded member can never join.
giv_case_error: Could not load the member file
giv_public_page_desc: Share the list of running giveaways, no login or dashboard access needed.
giveaway_public_meta_desc: Giveaways and prize draws running on {guildName}.
giveaway_public_disabled_desc: This server does not use the Giveaways module right now.
giveaway_public_empty_desc: No giveaway has been launched on this server yet.
giveaway_public_not_found_desc: This giveaway does not exist or does not belong to this server.
giveaway_public_winners_pending_note: These winners have been drawn and are awaiting an administrator's approval.
giveaway_public_no_winners: Nobody entered, so there is no winner.
giveaway_public_winners_hidden: Winners will be shown once the giveaway ends.
giveaway_public_join_hint: Entries happen on Discord, using the “Join” button on the message.
pulse_desc: Health score, forecasts and anomaly detection.
pulse_empty_desc: Pulse is computed every night on the completed day. Run a recompute to rebuild the available history.
pulse_pred_empty_desc: At least five complete days of history are needed to project a trend.
pulse_partial_hint: Provisional score, the day is not over.
pulse_confidence_low: Low confidence: history is short or irregular.
pulse_seasonality_low: Fewer than 14 days observed: profile is not reliable yet.
pulse_alert_insufficient_data: Not enough data yet for a reliable diagnosis.
pulse_alert_activity_critical: Very low activity - the server is dormant.
pulse_alert_activity_low: Activity below the server's normal level.
pulse_alert_moderation_critical: High sanction rate ({count}) - check ongoing conflicts.
pulse_alert_growth_critical: The server is losing members ({left} left) - investigate why.
pulse_alert_growth_churn: {left} departures for {joined} arrivals - retention is weak.
pulse_alert_engagement_low: Low engagement - few members take part actively.
pulse_alert_excellent: Excellent momentum - the server is thriving!
pulse_anomaly_spike: Abnormal spike in {metric} on {date}: {value} against {expected} expected.
pulse_anomaly_drop: Abnormal drop in {metric} on {date}: {value} against {expected} expected.
announcements_page_desc: Manage welcome messages, leaves, Discord boosts, and automatic role assignments.
announcements_guide_autorole_desc: Automatic assignment gives configured roles to members. The join auto-role applies immediately upon entry. The tag auto-role applies and removes automatically when a member updates their nickname or global name with the target tag.
announcements_guide_variables_desc: You can insert the following tags into your message templates to customize them dynamically:
announcements_boost_placeholder: Write the message to send when a member boosts...
announcements_autorole_join_desc: Automatically assigns a specific role to any new user joining the server.
announcements_autorole_tag_desc: Automatically assigns a role to members displaying this server's official tag on their Discord profile. The role is removed as soon as the member drops the tag.
announcements_autorole_tag_info: This is the server identity tag, unlocked by boosts and shown next to the nickname. Detection relies on the Discord API: no keyword to enter, and no false positives on nicknames.
announcements_autorole_status_desc: Scans members' custom status and/or current activity for a keyword and assigns a role accordingly. The role is removed as soon as the keyword disappears.
announcements_autorole_status_info: Discord does not expose a profile's "About me" section to bots: only the custom status and the current activity text can be read. The member must be online for their presence to be visible.
announcements_autorole_status_role_hint: Leave empty to reuse the tag auto-role's role, or pick a separate one.
announcements_autorole_rescan_desc: An auto-role only applies to members whose tag or status changes after it is enabled. Run a rescan to catch up with members already on the server.
announcements_thread_desc: When a member joins, the bot creates a dedicated thread in the selected channel, sends a sequence of scripted messages (webhook persona + typing indicator), and then a server introduction menu.
announcements_thread_inactivity_delete_d: Automatically deletes welcome threads with no activity, so they don't pile up in the channel
announcements_thread_persona_override_no: Each message in the sequence can override this name and avatar individually.
announcements_thread_sequence_desc: Messages sent in order, before the final menu.
announcements_thread_sequence_empty: No scripted message. The bot will go directly to the final menu.
announcements_thread_pages_desc: Each page becomes a button or option in the final menu.
announcements_thread_pages_empty: No page configured. The final menu will show no buttons.
announcements_role_exclusive_warning: Add at least one other 'Role' page in this same group. Selecting one will automatically remove the others.
announcements_role_exclusive_info: This role will automatically replace any other role currently held in the group.
announcements_role_toggle_info: 'Toggle' adds the role if absent, and removes it if already present.
announcements_link_note: Only available in 'Buttons' style: Discord then displays a real link button opening the channel or URL directly, bypassing the bot.
announcements_thread_sequence_empty_cont: Each message in the sequence must have content.
announcements_thread_page_missing_label_: Each page must have a label.
announcements_thread_page_embed_missing_: Embed pages must have a title and description.
announcements_thread_page_role_missing_e: Role pages must have a selected role.
announcements_thread_page_exclusive_miss: Each exclusive choice must belong to a group.
announcements_thread_page_exclusive_min_: The exclusive group '{groupName}' must contain at least two different roles.
announcements_thread_page_link_missing_e: Link pages must have a channel or URL.
reaction_roles_desc: Deploy messages with interactive buttons to assign roles to members.
reaction_roles_modal_desc: Configure role buttons and destination channel.
reaction_roles_preview_subtitle: Click the buttons below to assign or remove roles.
reaction_roles_all_buttons_required_erro: All buttons must have a label and a role.
reaction_roles_confirm_delete_desc: The Discord message will not be deleted automatically.
suggestions_page_desc: Review and moderate community suggestions with real-time voting.
suggestions_resolve_success: Decision saved and embed updated on Discord!
suggestions_public_comment_ph: Explain the decision made by the team...
suggestions_empty_desc: No suggestions found in this category. Members can propose them via the Discord command.
suggestions_config_section_desc: Set the channel where new suggestions are published on Discord.
triggers_page_desc: Configure instant actions (sending messages, granting/removing roles, or moderation) based on keywords, forms, or tickets.
triggers_bulk_delete_desc: Selected triggers will be permanently deleted.
triggers_action_required_error: Please configure at least one action (response, add/remove role, message deletion, close ticket, reject application, reaction, or advanced action).
triggers_modal_subtitle: Configure conditions and actions to execute.
triggers_modal_relay_staff_desc: Also sends a copy to the log channel of the linked staff server (if configured)
triggers_modal_reject_form_desc: Automatically rejects the application or form
triggers_modal_reactions_desc: The bot will automatically react to the message with these emojis.
triggers_modal_act_thread_desc: Automatically creates a public thread attached to the message
triggers_modal_act_dm_desc: Sends a direct message to the user who triggered the response
triggers_modal_act_timeout_desc: Temporarily mutes/excludes the member from the server
triggers_modal_act_xp_desc: Gives progression XP to the member
triggers_modal_act_xp_amount_label: Number of XP points to grant
triggers_modal_act_create_chan_desc: Creates a new dynamic Discord channel
triggers_modal_act_delete_chan_desc: Deletes the target channel or category
triggers_modal_act_create_role_desc: Creates a new role on the server
triggers_modal_act_delete_role_desc: Permanently deletes a role from the server
triggers_modal_total_weight_warning: Total appearance rate should ideally equal 100% (currently {weight}%).
triggers_modal_form_dm_warning: A form has no origin channel: message will be sent in DM.
embed_builder_desc: Design and edit complex, custom embed messages for your channels.
embed_builder_no_templates: No templates saved on this device.
embed_builder_msg_id_ph: Leave empty to send a new one
embed_builder_content_ph: Raw text to display outside the embed...
embed_builder_desc_ph: Main text content of your embed...
embed_builder_err_empty_field: All embed fields must have a title and content.
embed_builder_err_no_content: You must enter message text or fill at least one embed field.
embed_builder_preview_empty_hint: Enter information on the left to see the embed preview.
regulation_page_desc: Create, order and publish rule articles. Sanction report selections sync directly with this list.
regulation_staff_notice_hint: Each publication is announced to the staff announcement channel. No member is notified by DM.
regulation_no_articles_desc: Start by creating the first rule to define your community rules.
regulation_delete_modal_desc: Do you really want to delete {rule}? This action will remove the rule from all future reports.
regulation_warning_modal_desc1: Enabling rules verification can cause Discord permission conflicts and accidentally grant read access to {everyone} on certain private channels.
regulation_warning_modal_desc2: Ensure your private channels explicitly deny message read permissions for the {everyone} role.
regulation_no_publish_channel: Please select a publication channel first.
regulation_republished: Rules refreshed and republished on Discord!
banner_wip_desc: The {page} page is currently under development and is not available yet.
banner_unsaved_desc: You have unsaved changes on \"{page}\". Leave without saving?
channel_links_page_desc: Link channels across several servers to keep messages in sync
channel_links_empty_desc: Create a bridge to sync messages between a channel of this server and channels of one or more other servers.
channel_links_guest_banner_title: The other server needs no activation key
channel_links_guest_banner_desc: A server linked without a key runs in link-only mode: the bot merely mirrors the messages of the linked channel. No other module is active and no activity data is recorded there - its events never even reach the collection modules.
channel_links_guest_step_1: Invite the bot to the other server (it will not ask for a code).
channel_links_guest_step_2: Generate a link code here from the settings of the channel to bridge.
channel_links_guest_step_3: On the other server, run /link accept code:<code>. /link status details there, at any time, what runs and what is stored.
channel_links_badge_link_only_tooltip: This server has no activation key: Kotbo only relays this channel there and collects nothing.
channel_links_storage_notice_on: Edits, deletions, reactions and pins require storing the mapping between a message and its copy (identifiers only, never the content).
channel_links_storage_notice_off: No database write for the messages relayed by this link.
channel_links_no_guilds_desc: The bot must be present and you must be an admin on the target server.
channel_links_option_invite_desc: Creates an invite link to put in the target server's description
channel_links_invite_created_hint: Copy this link and add it to the target server's description:
channel_links_err_target_required: Pick a channel for every selected server
channel_links_invite_section_desc: Generate a permanent invite link for this channel to put in the linked server's description.
channel_links_invite_added_topic: Invite added to distant channel description
channel_links_invite_manual_hint: The bot could not update the distant channel description. Copy the link manually:
channel_links_delete_modal_desc: Are you sure you want to delete this bridge? Messages will no longer be relayed between its channels.
channel_links_targets_hint: Pick as many servers as you want: every selected channel relays to all the others.
channel_links_last_members_notice: A bridge needs at least two channels: removing one more will delete it.
channel_links_add_member_heading: Add a server to the bridge
channel_links_remove_member_tooltip: Remove this channel from the bridge
channel_links_err_add_member: Select a server and a channel
channel_links_perm_missing_everyone: Discord strips emojis and stickers from other servers as long as @everyone lacks these permissions in this channel: {perms}. The bridge webhook borrows @everyone's rights.
channel_links_perm_missing_bot: The bot lacks these permissions in this channel: {perms}. Relaying will be incomplete.
channel_links_perm_channel_missing: The bot can no longer see this channel: nothing is relayed there.
staff_server_page_desc: Link staff servers to automatically synchronize roles and hierarchy
staff_server_mode_main_to_staff_desc: Hierarchy is managed here, a simple role is granted on the staff server
staff_server_mode_staff_to_main_desc: Hierarchy is managed on the staff server, a simple role is granted here
staff_server_mode_bidirectional_desc: Hierarchy is synchronized across both servers
staff_server_empty_desc: Link a dedicated staff Discord server to automatically synchronize roles and hierarchy.
staff_server_no_mappings_desc: No mapping configured. Add role correspondences between the two servers.
staff_server_cross_notifs_desc: Staff server channels that will receive notifications from this main server.
staff_server_hint_modlog_mirror: Copy of automod, ghost ping, and honeypot alerts
staff_server_hint_sanction_report: Embed posted for each new sanction report
staff_server_hint_offboarding_alert: Alert with kick button when a member loses all staff roles
staff_server_hint_onboarding_invite: Source channel for invite links sent to new staff
staff_server_hint_recruitment_category: Staff server category to create interview channels in
staff_server_toggle_onboarding_desc: Sends a DM invite to the staff server upon receiving the first staff role
staff_server_toggle_recruitment_desc: Creates interview channels on the staff server instead of here
staff_server_hint_bot_present: The bot must be present on this server.
staff_server_delete_modal_desc: Are you sure you want to delete this link? Roles will no longer be synchronized between the two servers.
channel_health_page_desc: Automatic activity analysis and alerts for your channels.
channel_health_monitor_disabled_desc: Enable the monitor to automatically analyze your channels' activity and receive recommendations.
channel_health_no_analysis_desc: Click \"Run analysis\" to evaluate your channels' health.
channel_health_no_alerts_desc: All your channels are healthy. Alerts will appear here when recommendations are detected.
channel_health_field_excluded_channels_h: These channels are left out of the analysis and never raise an alert. Useful for intentionally quiet channels (honeypot, archives, announcements).
channel_health_not_configured_desc: The monitor is not configured yet for this server.
ch_presets_desc: A sensitivity sets the overload and underuse thresholds and the analysis window in one go. Click the one that suits you, then save.
ch_presets_save_hint: Nothing is applied until you save.
ch_presets_already_saved: This is already the saved configuration.
ch_presets_module_off: The monitor is disabled: turn it on in the detailed configuration for the analysis to run.
ch_presets_users_note: An overload also needs {overload} active members, and an underused channel at most {underused}.
ch_presets_scope_note: A sensitivity only changes the thresholds. Automatic splitting and archiving, as well as the weekly digest, stay in the detailed configuration.
ch_preset_lenient_desc: Wide thresholds over a month: only truly saturated or truly dead channels show up.
ch_preset_balanced_desc: The recommended thresholds, over two weeks: enough hindsight to ignore a passing lull.
ch_preset_strict_desc: Tight thresholds over a week: alerts come early, at the cost of getting more of them.
ch_preset_custom_desc: Your own thresholds, set one by one in the detailed configuration.
commands_page_desc: Manage access permissions and inspect your commands' structure.
commands_err_admin_only: Only administrators can modify these settings.
commands_save_failed_toast: Unable to save command restrictions at this time.
commands_empty_select_desc: Choose a command from the list to view its documentation and configure access permissions.
commands_no_params_or_subs: This command has no parameters or subcommands.
commands_conflict_desc: Some items are simultaneously allowed and blocked.
news_page_desc_public: Browse the latest announcements published for this server.
news_page_desc_admin: Draft announcements, patch notes and generate the server RSS feed.
news_field_title_ph: Ex: Update v1.4.0 or Security Patch Notes...
news_publish_mode_sub: This choice is used when publishing immediately or when a draft is published.
news_rss_card_desc: This RSS feed is dynamically generated from articles marked as **published**. Your members can subscribe on Feedly, Inoreader, or any RSS reader.
news_rss_copied_toast: RSS feed link copied to clipboard!
news_search_ph: Search by title, summary or author...
news_forum_view_desc: Articles are grouped by category then subcategory to mimic a forum structure.
news_empty_desc: Start by writing your first update or patch note.
news_config_desc: Organize each category like a newspaper section, with dedicated feeds and associated Discord channels.
news_config_new_desc: Link a category or subcategory to a channel to publish announcements like a newsroom.
news_config_index_desc: Each row represents an editorial section with its broadcast channel and public RSS feed.
news_config_discord_linked: Discord broadcast linked to this editorial section.
news_config_rss_ready: Ready to be consumed by an RSS reader
news_config_empty_desc: Create the first link on the left to enable editorial broadcasting and the public RSS feed.
news_err_category_channel_req: Category and Discord channel are required.
fun_page_desc: Configure interactive game channels to entertain your community.
fun_oneword_hint: This game automatically regulates the channel. Incorrect messages are deleted and double-posting is blocked.
fun_punitive_desc: On a mistake (counting, word chain), the game resets to zero. Disabled: the offending message is deleted and its author warned, without breaking the progress.
fun_wordchain_subtitle: Each word must start with the previous word's last letter
fun_emojiriddle_subtitle: Guess the phrase hidden behind the emojis
fun_neversay_hint: This game moderates the channel automatically: any message containing the French words "oui" or "non" (yes/no) is deleted.
fun_emojionly_hint: This game moderates the channel automatically: any message containing anything but emojis is deleted.
social_page_desc: Subscribe to YouTube and Twitch channels and configure their Discord alerts.
social_banner_desc: YouTube & Twitch are managed by background tasks. Make sure the corresponding modules are enabled in the
social_yt_err_query_req: Please provide the YouTube channel link or name.
social_twitch_err_query_req: Please provide the Twitch username or link.
social_empty_hint: Fill out the form on the left to get started.
backups_page_desc: Manage and restore the configuration, channels, roles and members of your Discord server.
backups_empty_desc: Create your first backup to secure your server.
backups_restore_toast: Restore started successfully. The server will be restored.
backups_case_error: Unable to load the case file
backups_import_section_desc: Do you have a backup file in JSON format? Import it directly to the server.
backups_field_name_ph: Leave empty for the default name
backups_delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete the backup {name}?
backups_restore_confirm: Do you want to restore the backup {name} on this server?
backups_restore_warning: This action will overwrite the server's current configuration with the backup data. The bot will apply the saved roles, channels and permissions.
schedules_description: Configure and automate recurring actions on your Discord server.
schedules_empty_desc: Create your first schedule to automate recurring tasks.
schedules_form_cron_placeholder: * * * * * (minute, hour, day, month, day of week)
schedules_form_cron_help: Standard Unix cron format. e.g.: `0 12 * * *` for every noon.
schedules_confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete the schedule {name}?
schedules_err_target_required: A target channel is required for this action type.
mcp_description: Connect an AI (Claude, ChatGPT...) to your bot to query and manage your Discord server.
mcp_endpoint_notice: Paste this URL into your AI client. The server supports OAuth 2.0 with PKCE for Claude/ChatGPT, and Bearer token for MCP clients that require it.
mcp_empty_desc: Create a key to connect your AI agent.
mcp_direct_url_desc: Use if Claude finishes OAuth and still displays \"Authorization failed\".
mcp_direct_url_expires: Expires on {date}. Revoking the key also invalidates this URL.
mcp_perm_read_members_desc: Profiles, recent messages, reading forums and posts
mcp_perm_read_community_desc: Leaderboards, suggestions, events, quests, reputation, custom onboarding, clan bets and debts
mcp_perm_read_economy_desc: RPG profiles, shop, marketplace, economic leaderboards
mcp_perm_read_moderation_desc: AutoMod, banned words, auto responses, CodePolice
mcp_perm_read_analytics_desc: Per-channel stats, hourly heatmap, Pulse, predictions

prg_ladder_custom_notice: The running ladder was edited tier by tier: it no longer matches the sliders above. Saving will replace it with the one they describe.
prg_ladder_exponent_hint: 1 = constant gaps; above that, every tier costs more than the previous one.
prg_ladder_divisions_hint: Bronze I, II, III: the family name changes every N tiers. The summit never has a division.
prg_ladder_preview_desc: RP gap to clear for each tier, from the first one to the summit.
prg_ladder_population_desc: Where your ranked members would land under the ladder shown, at unchanged RP.
prg_ladder_impact: {changed} members out of {total} would change tier.
prg_ladder_warning: Changing the ladder re-tiers members without touching their RP: the summit will require {apex} RP. Roles only move on request, below.
prg_estimate_intro: Estimated time to reach these tiers, for a member who is:
prg_tier_roles_hint: The role a member wears for their tier, created and assigned by the bot.
prg_roles_provision_desc: {count} tiers have no role yet. The bot creates them on Discord, in the ladder colours, with no permissions at all.
prg_roles_provision_done: All {count} ladder tiers already have their role.
prg_roles_created_none: Nothing to create: every tier already has its role.
prg_roles_delete_desc: {count} roles are bound to a tier. The bot deletes them from Discord and frees the tiers.
prg_roles_delete_none: No role is bound to a tier.
prg_roles_delete_confirm_desc: The roles are removed from Discord and from every member wearing them. This cannot be undone.
prg_roles_deleted_partial: {deleted} roles deleted, {failed} out of the bot's reach: move its role above the tier roles.
prg_roles_sync_desc: The bot only revisits roles on the next RP gain, so never for an inactive member. This pass brings everyone up to date at once.
prg_roles_sync_started: Assignment started: it keeps running in the background.
prg_roles_err_permission: The bot is missing the “Manage Roles” permission.
prg_roles_err_limit: Discord caps a server at 250 roles: lower the number of tiers.
prg_roles_err_guild: The server is unreachable right now.
prg_roles_err_disabled: Turn on automatic tier-role assignment first.
prg_roles_err_none: No tier role is linked yet: create them first.
prg_setup_roles_desc: {count} tiers are still waiting for their Discord role. The bot can create and assign them for you.
prg_setup_roles_done: All {count} ladder tiers have their role.
prg_gains_inherits_levels: RP derive from XP: ignored channels, ignored roles and multipliers are set on the Levels page and apply here automatically.
prg_role_missing_hint: The linked role no longer exists on Discord: this tier grants nothing.
prg_roles_orphan_desc: {count} links point to tiers that are absent from the current ladder. Their roles still exist on Discord but nothing grants or removes them any more.
prg_section_announce_hint: Where the bot announces tier changes, and which ones it announces.
prg_announce_channel_desc: Without a channel, tier changes still show on the rank card but are announced nowhere.
prg_announce_channel_missing: The saved channel no longer exists: announcements go nowhere.
prg_section_messages_hint: Left empty, these are the default messages, translated into the server's language.
prg_messages_empty_hint: Clearing a field restores the default message.
prg_streak_off_grid: The saved streak settings do not match any step: the slider shows the closest one. Switch to advanced mode to see the real values.
prg_streak_preview_desc: Bonus applied to RP gains, per consecutive streak day.
prg_decay_off_grid: The saved decay settings do not match any step: the slider shows the closest one. Switch to advanced mode to see the real values.
prg_decay_preview_desc: RP left to a member who walked away with {rp} RP, day after day.
prg_board_search_placeholder: Search a name or an ID…
prg_board_search_limited: Too many results: refine the search to see the missing members.
prg_global_hint: Sum of a member's RP across every server taking part in the cross-server leaderboard.
prg_global_empty: No member on the global leaderboard yet.
prg_global_opted_out: This server does not take part in the global leaderboard: turn the option on in the Announcements tab.
prg_member_history_empty: No RP movement recorded in the last 30 days.
prg_member_not_found: This member has no RP on this server yet.
prg_member_adjust_hint: An adjustment goes through the same path as a normal gain: it can trigger a tier change, a role and an announcement.
prestige_public_error_loading: Could not load the prestige leaderboard.
prestige_public_disabled_desc: This server has not enabled the prestige leaderboard, or has made it private.
no_guild_access_desc: Your Discord account has no permissions on any server where Kotbo is installed. Ask an administrator to grant you a role, or invite the bot to your server, then try again.
no_feature_access_desc: Your role on this server does not grant access to this page. Contact a server administrator if you think this is a mistake.
clan_bets_desc: Two members challenge each other on any subject and stake clan points. Only a referee settles it.
clan_bets_requires_clans: The Clans module is off: bets stay inactive until it is turned back on.
clan_bets_channel_desc: Channel where the /paris command is accepted. With no setting, it works in every channel, and the bet is posted where it was started.
clan_bets_announcement_desc: Channel for the summary posted once the verdict is in. With no setting, it appears in the channel where the bet was opened.
clan_bets_shapes_desc: Duels are always available. Other formats settle the same way: the winning side shares the pot.
clan_bets_allow_pool_desc: Several bettors, a single winner who takes the whole pot.
clan_bets_allow_teams_desc: Sides facing off. The winning side shares the pot in proportion to what each member staked.
clan_bets_allow_open_desc: Allow duels started with no named opponent, which anyone can take up. Pools and teams are always open, under their own setting.
clan_bets_stake_mode_desc: Per person: everyone stakes the same amount, so an outnumbered side gets better odds. Per side: the stake is split across the side's seats, which requires declaring how many there are when the bet is created.
clan_bets_max_participants_desc: Caps the size of the pot, across all seats.
clan_bets_max_sides_desc: Each side gets its own button in the announcement: beyond that it becomes unreadable.
clan_bets_reward_desc: When a season closes, the top bettors receive a title and a bonus. Only a positive net gain is rewarded: a season where everyone lost crowns nobody.
clan_bets_reward_role_desc: Optional: with no role, only the bonuses are paid, and if the bonuses are zero the podium is simply announced. The role is removed from its previous holders at every closure, like the clan leader role, then given to the winner - or to all of them on a tie.
clan_bets_reward_amounts_desc: Clan points paid into the next season: credited to the one just closed, they would show up in no readable ranking. Leave at zero to award the title only. A bettor in debt sees the bonus go to repayment first.
clan_bets_debt_desc: Allows staking more points than a member holds. The shortfall becomes a debt, taken from later gains.
clan_bets_max_debt_desc: Maximum debt per member. Past it, no further bet on credit is accepted.
clan_bets_debt_reset_desc: Off, a debt survives seasons: otherwise waiting for the close is enough to owe nothing.
clan_bets_debt_clear_desc: The firm share disappears with nothing in return: nobody pays it back.
clan_bets_debt_clear_engaged_note: {amount} point(s) are still staked on running bets. Without the box below, that share stays owed until the bet is settled.
clan_bets_debt_clear_include_engaged: also clear the debt from their running bets
clan_bets_debt_cleared_partial: Firm debt cleared. {amount} point(s) remain staked on running bets.
clan_bets_managers_desc: Hand refereeing to a team without opening up server administration.
clan_bets_managers_scope_winner: Name the winner of a running bet.
clan_bets_managers_scope_cancel: Cancel a bet and return both stakes.
clan_bets_managers_empty: No role: only administrators can manage bets.
clan_bets_managers_admin_note: Administrators keep this right in every case.
clan_points_debt_repaid: Points added, but {amount} went to repaying the member's debt.
drop_page_desc: Randomly drop XP, clan points or coins into your channels and let members claim them.
drop_type_desc_rpg_item: A game item drops in the channel and lands in the winner's inventory. Only the items you list can drop.
drop_item_pool_desc: The drop picks one at random each time it appears. With an empty list, no item drop is published.
drop_item_pool_empty: No item selected: this drop type will publish nothing.
drop_item_total_error: Rates must add up to 100%, they currently add up to {total}.
drop_item_pool_full: You can list up to {max} items.
drop_item_pool_rpg_off: The RPG is disabled: a dropped item would have no inventory to land in, and nothing will be published.
drop_item_quantity_hint: The amounts below are a number of copies, not points.
drop_global_desc: Apply to all four drop types. Each type keeps its own channel, frequency and amounts.
drop_enable_desc: Master switch: turned off here, no drop appears, whatever each type is set to.
drop_default_channel_desc: Used by drop types that have no channel of their own.
drop_mention_role_desc: Pinged on every drop. Leave empty to notify nobody.
drop_lifetime_desc: After that, an unclaimed drop closes. The open-to-all mode has its own duration.
drop_overview_desc: Status of the four drop types configured on this server.
drop_history_desc: What actually landed in your channels, and how many members claimed it.
drop_type_enable_desc: Enables drops of this resource. The master switch must be on as well.
drop_type_desc_xp: Progression XP: counts towards levels and role rewards.
drop_type_desc_rpg_xp: RPG module XP, independent from server levels.
drop_type_desc_clan_points: Clan points credited to the claimer's clan. They show up tagged as Drop on the public page.
drop_type_desc_coins: Economy currency, credited to the member's balance.
drop_channel_desc: Leave on the default channel to follow the global setting.
drop_interval_desc: Average gap between two drops. The exact time is drawn between half and one and a half times this interval, so nobody can camp the channel.
drop_interval_hint: About {count} drop(s) per day on average.
drop_min_gap_hint: Two drops on the same server never land less than five minutes apart, all types combined.
drop_no_mode_warning: No claim mode is active: this type will not produce any drop.
drop_no_channel_warning: No channel for this type and no default channel: drops would be posted nowhere.
drop_clans_disabled_warning: Clans are disabled: a clan points drop would credit nobody.
drop_module_disabled_warning: The {module} module is disabled: the reward would still be credited, but members could not use it while it stays off.
drop_modes_desc: Enable one or several. On each drop the bot picks one at random among those enabled, using the reward range set here.
drop_mode_first_desc: A single winner: the first to click takes it all.
drop_mode_race_desc: The first to click each receive the announced amount.
drop_mode_window_desc: Anyone can help themselves for the given duration.
drop_min_open_hint: Five minutes minimum: below that, only members already watching the channel would get a chance to click.
drop_save_error: Error while saving the drops configuration.
clan_public_credit_share_desc: Share of this stake paid with points the member did not have. It stays out of the score and will be taken from their next gains.
clan_public_debt_clan_clear: No member of this clan is in debt.
clan_public_debt_empty: Nobody owes points on this server.
clan_public_debt_unaffiliated_desc: Debt follows the member, not the clan: they carry it into whichever clan they join next.
clan_public_credit_badge_hint: Points this clan's members still owe from betting on credit. They are not part of the total shown: betting on credit adds nothing to the bettor's score. Credit staked on unsettled bets is left out too, as long as the verdict can wipe it.
clan_public_bettors_desc: Net gains for the season. A win pays the opponent's stake, never your own.
clan_public_bettors_rewards: Podium rewarded at season close: {top1} / {top2} / {top3} clan points.
clan_public_bettors_rewards_role: The winner also gets the {role} role.
clan_public_bets_desc: Who challenged whom, on what, and for how much.
clan_public_debt_engaged_desc: Share of the debt staked on unsettled bets: it vanishes if the bet falls through or when the season ends.
clan_public_debt_average_hint: What an indebted member owes on average, taken from their next clan-point gains.
clan_board_empty_desc: This server has enabled neither clans nor the RPG. As soon as one of them is open, the ranking, raids and quests appear here.
mcm_xlink_score_hint: Bonus added to the detection score: it grows with the number of servers carrying this link.
mcm_xlink_apply_reason: Link already present on {count} other server(s): {servers}
mcm_xlink_footer_hint: Nothing is linked automatically - you decide.
starboard_page_desc: Reposts the messages people react to as highlights, in a dedicated channel.
starboard_load_error: Could not load the Starlight configuration.
starboard_section_publication_desc: Where highlighted messages are reposted, and from which score.
starboard_channel_hint: Without a channel the module stays idle: nothing gets published.
starboard_threshold_hint: Score (upvotes minus downvotes) required to get reposted.
starboard_section_votes_desc: Which emojis count, and where they count.
starboard_upvotes_hint: At least one is required. The first one is used as the highlight counter.
starboard_downvotes_hint: Subtracted from the score. Leave empty to disable downvoting.
starboard_count_embed_desc: Votes cast on the reposted message feed the same score. That is often where members vote.
starboard_section_autoreact_desc: Add the vote emojis upfront, so nobody has to look for them.
starboard_autoreact_embed_desc: The bot adds the vote emojis to every reposted message.
starboard_autoreact_channels_hint: Every new message there gets the vote emojis: this is what turns a channel into a suggestion box.
starboard_section_scope_desc: Which channels are watched, and which are excluded.
starboard_watched_hint: Leave empty to watch the whole server.
starboard_ignored_hint: Always take precedence over watched channels.
starboard_allow_bots_desc: Take messages posted by bots and webhooks into account.
starboard_section_lifecycle_desc: What happens to a highlight whose score drops back down.
starboard_remove_below_desc: The highlight is deleted if the score falls back under the threshold. Otherwise it stays published once reached.
starboard_no_channel_warning: Without a publishing channel, Starlight reposts nothing. Pick one below.
ba_contested_hint: Each sanction gets its own verdict. Apply them, then issue the overall decision to notify the member.
ba_item_sanction_gone: This sanction was deleted from the database.
ba_item_delete_desc: The sanction will disappear from the record and cannot be restored. Prefer archiving if you want to keep a trace.
ba_scope_desc: Enable, one by one, the sanction types members can appeal. With nothing but Ban ticked, the module behaves exactly as before.
ba_dm_on_sanction_desc: On every appealable sanction, the member gets a link to the appeal page, already pointing at the right sanction.
ba_exclude_moderator: Bar moderators from judging their own sanction
ba_exclude_moderator_desc: Whoever issued the sanction cannot decide the appeal against it.
ba_notify_moderator_desc: They get a DM when one of their sanctions is appealed, and can add context before the verdict.
ba_mod_stats_desc: A high overturn rate points at poorly issued sanctions, not at a lenient staff.
pa_pick_sanctions_desc: Tick the ones you want to appeal ({count} at most) and explain your side for each.
pa_statement_placeholder: Why do you feel this sanction was unfair?
pa_select_sanction: Select at least one sanction to appeal.
pa_max_sanctions: You can only appeal {count} sanction(s) at a time.
pa_nothing_desc: You have no appealable sanction on this server right now.
sc_bulk_archive_desc: They leave the active record and stop counting towards the warn score, but stay stored and readable.
sc_bulk_unarchive_title: Restore these infractions to the active record?
sc_bulk_unarchive_desc: They count again towards the warn score and automatic escalation.
sc_bulk_lock_desc: The member will never be able to appeal these infractions again, even after the waiting period.
sc_bulk_unlock_desc: The member will be able to request a review again.
sc_bulk_delete_desc: The infractions disappear from the database and cannot be restored. Prefer archiving to keep a trace.
da_warn_auto_archive_hint: Past this delay a warn is archived automatically: it leaves the active record without being erased. Empty or 0 = never.
da_count_archived_desc: By default an archived sanction no longer weighs on the warn score or escalation. Tick this to keep it counting (purely visual archiving).
commands_info_discord: You can also manage these permissions directly in Discord (Server Settings → Integrations).
commands_roles_hint: No role selected = default Discord behaviour (based on the command permissions). Administrators always keep access to enabled commands.
commands_disabled_notice: Command turned off for the whole server, administrators included. Re-enable it to configure access.
mgmt_page_desc: Cross-cutting settings for the server, its modules and their access.
mgmt_no_access_desc: Administrative permissions are required for this area.
mgmt_preset_confirm_desc: Current access rules will be overwritten, and pending changes lost.
ma_hint_open: No rule: every staff member sees this section. Granting "View" to a role closes it to all the others.
ma_hint_restricted: Allowlist active: only roles with "View" reach this section. Discord administrators are never filtered out.
onb_tracks_title: What would you like to set up today?
onb_tracks_lead: Everything can also be configured later, from the dashboard. Whatever you tick here, we set up together now.
onb_tracks_group_hint: Unticking disables nothing: we simply won't ask the question.
onb_tracks_none: Nothing ticked: you'll go straight to activation.
onb_track_structure_outcome: Kotbo lays out a full tree before your eyes, permissions included.
onb_track_moderation_outcome: Spam, invite links and suspicious join waves are blocked without you.
onb_track_logs_outcome: A deleted message stays readable, and every action lands in a log channel.
onb_track_greeting_pitch: The first message a newcomer reads
onb_track_greeting_outcome: Every new member is greeted by name, in the channel you choose.
onb_track_rules_outcome: A complete set of rules, published in its channel, that you never had to write.
onb_track_tickets_outcome: Members open a private ticket in one click, with your reasons and your colour.
onb_track_levels_outcome: Active members level up and earn roles, on their own.
onb_track_economy_outcome: Your own currency, a /daily and a shop to spend it in.
onb_track_animation_outcome: Goals that renew every day and rewards that land in the channel.
onb_track_staff_outcome: Kotbo knows who moderates, and gives you their activity statistics.
onb_track_mcp_pitch: Your Discord from Claude or ChatGPT
onb_track_mcp_outcome: “How many messages this week?” — ask an AI, it reads your server.
onb_migration_bots_title: Let's see what's already running here
onb_migration_bots_lead: Your server isn't empty, and Kotbo shouldn't pretend otherwise. Here's what it recognised.
onb_migration_bots_none_lead: Nothing to recover on that side: we start from what the server already holds.
onb_migration_findings_lead: Nothing is written without your say-so. Untick whatever you'd rather set up yourself.
onb_migration_findings_none: Nothing to recover automatically: your setup happens on the next screens.
onb_migration_manual_title: What will still need doing by hand
onb_migration_manual_hint: Kotbo can't guess these without risking a mistake. We'll come back to them from the dashboard.
onb_logs_title: What should be kept of what's said?
onb_logs_lead: A deleted message is only lost if nobody wrote it down. Kotbo keeps a copy, for as long as you decide.
onb_logs_channel_hint: Staff only: Kotbo writes deletions, joins and sanctions there.
onb_logs_channel_none: No channel — publish nothing on Discord
onb_logs_retention_short_detail: The useful minimum: a weekend report is still actionable on Monday. Beyond that, everything is erased.
onb_logs_retention_standard_detail: Covers almost every report, without keeping years of conversations.
onb_logs_retention_long_detail: For an exposed server, or when disputes go back a long way. Remember to tell your members.
onb_staff_lead: Point out your team's roles: Kotbo will know who to alert, and will track each person's activity.
onb_staff_empty: No roles to offer yet. Kotbo may have created one during the build: it will show up after a refresh.
onb_staff_alert_hint: Sanctions, reports and raid alerts land there.
onb_staff_mode_create_hint: Kotbo creates the roles, in order, with the right permissions.
onb_staff_mode_existing_hint: Tick the roles your team is already made of.
onb_staff_poles_hint: They sit between the admins and the moderators: high enough for their calls to carry, low enough for those calls to be reviewed.
onb_staff_ladder_hint: Roles are created top to bottom, in this exact order. You can rename them on Discord without breaking anything.
onb_staff_preview_hint: Kotbo will count sanctions, handled tickets and presence for every member of these roles.
onb_economy_lead: It's the word your members read on every gain, every purchase, every leaderboard. It may as well be yours.
onb_economy_rhythm_label: How fast do people earn it?
onb_economy_rhythm_discreet_detail: A modest /daily, once a day. What you buy is earned over time.
onb_economy_rhythm_standard_detail: A regular member affords their first item within the week, then picks their spending.
onb_economy_rhythm_generous_detail: Gains are visible on day one. Pick this if the shop is well stocked.
onb_economy_preview_daily_line: You received {amount} {currency}. Come back in {hours} h.
onb_economy_shop_lead: A currency that buys nothing is just a counter. Three items are enough to make it credible; the rest can come later.
onb_economy_shop_empty: No items selected: the shop stays empty for now.
onb_quests_title: Give them a reason to come back tomorrow
onb_quests_lead: Goals that renew every day. They target ordinary gestures: talking, reacting, joining voice.
onb_drops_lead: At unpredictable intervals, Kotbo posts a reward the first to react takes. It's an interruption: that's what makes it worth something.
onb_drops_rhythm_rare_detail: Rare enough that people look up. Pick this if the channel is already busy.
onb_drops_rhythm_standard_detail: The default rhythm: present without taking over.
onb_drops_rhythm_frequent_detail: Wakes up a quiet channel. On a busy one, it ends up cutting conversations short.
onb_drops_preview_line: First to click takes the reward.
onb_mcp_title: Run your Discord by talking to it
onb_mcp_lead: Kotbo exposes your server to an AI — Claude, ChatGPT, or any compatible client. You ask, it reads your data and answers.
onb_mcp_scope_label: What the AI will be allowed to do
onb_mcp_scope_read_detail: Statistics, members, tickets, economy. No sanctions, no messages posted. The recommended choice.
onb_mcp_scope_moderate_pitch: It can sanction and answer tickets
onb_mcp_scope_moderate_detail: Adds sanctions and ticket replies. An AI that gets it wrong bans someone: keep this for supervised use.
onb_mcp_scope_full_detail: It can write in your channels and edit your members. Only give this key to a client you control.
onb_mcp_key_warning: Copy it now: it won't be shown in full again. A lost key is replaced from the MCP page.
onb_mcp_url_label: Address to paste into your client
onb_mcp_example_1: How many new members this week?
onb_mcp_example_2: Which channel is busiest right now?
onb_mcp_example_3: Summarise the open tickets for me.
onb_mcp_preview_answer: 47 joins over the last 7 days, up 18 % on the previous week. The peak is Saturday evening, right after the announcement.
onb_sim_reason_young: Account created less than 24 h ago
onb_sim_caption_light: Light: only the obvious is blocked. The rest of the conversation goes through.
onb_sim_caption_standard: Balanced: spam, links and mention bursts are removed.
onb_sim_caption_strict: Strict: everything above, plus accounts that are too new held aside.
onb_recap_lead: Everything below is already running on {server}.
onb_recap_settings: {count} settings put in place in {minutes} minutes.
onb_recap_missing_hint: There's still time: these screens join the journey in one click.
ma_perm_view_desc: Open the section and read its data. Without it, the page leaves the navigation and the API refuses even reads.
ma_perm_moderate_desc: Act on what the section holds day to day - handle, decide, answer - without touching its settings.
ma_perm_configure_desc: Change the section settings. This is the right that allows saving, beyond plain reading.
ma_perm_delete_desc: Erase within the section: meetings, automations, staff ranks and warnings, quests, ticket macros and blacklist. A role that configures a section may still not erase from it.
mcp_key_orphan_hint: Key created before keys were tied to an account. It keeps answering even if whoever uses it loses access to the server: revoke and recreate it so it follows its holder.
mc_intro: A disabled module really does stop working: its commands, buttons, scheduled tasks and settings page all become unavailable.
mc_cat_core_desc: Foundations of the bot and the dashboard. Always on.
mc_cat_moderation_desc: Sanctions, logs, automatic filtering and server protection.
mc_cat_staff_desc: Recruitment, hierarchy, meetings, absences and team follow-up.
mc_cat_community_desc: Progression, economy, games, events and member interactions.
mc_cat_content_desc: Rules, welcome, news, auto-responses and publishing.
mc_cat_integrations_desc: External services plugged into the server.
mc_presets_desc: Applies a set of modules and permissions suited to a type of server in one go. Replaces the settings involved.
mc_preset_general_desc: Translation on, dev modules idle, admin commands kept in check.
mc_preset_gaming_desc: Translation on, simple moderation stack, focus on player channels.
mc_preset_dev_desc: Daily Algo and Code Police on, technical commands open.
mc_preset_confirm_desc: Some current settings will be replaced.
mc_state_plan_desc: This module is not part of the server's current plan.
mc_state_core_desc: Core module: it cannot be turned off.
mc_state_active_desc: Commands, events and settings page available.
mc_state_inactive_desc: Commands refused, events ignored, page unreachable.
mc_role_access_desc: Who can view, moderate and configure this module from the dashboard.
mc_confirm_disable_desc: Will be turned off at the same time: {list}.
mc_toast_toggle_error: Could not change the state of “{name}”.
us_timezone_desc: Chart and heatmap hours are shown in this time zone. Currently: {zone}.
mod_dashboard_desc: Dashboard home page and summary widgets.
mod_modules_desc: Turning the bot's modules on and configuring them.
mod_settings_desc: General server settings, system channels and base roles.
mod_commands_desc: Permissions and restrictions for Discord commands.
mod_activity_desc: Timestamped trail of staff actions on the dashboard and Discord.
mod_members_desc: Search, member profiles and individual moderation actions.
mod_profile_desc: Members' personal profile and account preferences.
mod_sanctions_desc: Warnings, mutes, bans, records and sanction reports.
mod_automod_desc: Automatic filtering: spam, links, caps, mentions, banned words.
mod_logs_desc: Discord event logs: messages, channels, roles, members.
mod_nickname_moderation_desc: Detecting and automatically renaming non-compliant nicknames.
mod_double_accounts_desc: Detecting multiple accounts and matching identities.
mod_raid_protection_desc: Detecting join waves and automatically locking the server down.
mod_ban_appeals_desc: Public appeal form and handling of the requests.
mod_codepolice_desc: Checking syntax and good practice on code snippets.
mod_security_verification_desc: Captcha and verification flow when members arrive.
mod_recruitment_desc: Staff applications, forms and interview follow-up.
mod_staff_directory_desc: List, profiles and statistics for the team.
mod_staff_roles_desc: Levels, promotions and staff role synchronisation.
mod_tutoring_desc: Trial periods, mentoring and follow-up for new staff.
mod_meetings_desc: Scheduling, invitations and minutes for team meetings.
mod_absences_desc: Declaring and tracking staff leave and unavailability.
